SAPTA

Student Artists' Platform for Talent and Aspiration

About SAPTA

SAPTA is a non-profit, student-led organization that promotes Carnatic music. While providing students of all levels opportunities to perform, they also have a way to showcase their talents in unique ways. Proceeds of the funds will go to support underfunded areas in our Tri-Valley community.

Meet the Team

Ananya Aiyer

President

Ananya is a freshman at DVHS with a love for Carnatic music and a talent for bringing people together. She founded SAPTA to create a space where student musicians can perform, grow, and give back to the community.

SAPTA Events

Go-Rakshana

Where Nada meets Karuna

June 13, 2026
3 PM - 5 PM
Sri Karpaga Ganapathi Temple, San Ramon, CA

Proceeds from this event went to support Shri Krishna Brundavan Gokulam (1125 Finley Rd, Pleasanton, CA). The concert featured beautiful Carnatic vocal and instrumental music by student artists, showcasing talent while nurturing our local community.

Event Gallery

Eka

It All Begins with One

March 14, 2026
2 PM - 4 PM
Sri Karpaga Ganapathi Temple, San Ramon, CA

SAPTA's inaugural event — 'Eka' (meaning One) — celebrated the launch of the Student Artists' Platform with student vocal and instrumental Carnatic performances. Proceeds went directly to support the Sri Karpaga Ganapathi Temple.
